context:
Using the [Governance of Digital Minds](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1et-TIGBRbHg2lLBkKwCCQCrq2p975b8q1KdpP_nnnpI/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.cuighsf9mc3l) primer as inspiration, choose either: 
- one area of **recent legal action** _or_ 
- one **legal framework**
**Spend 10 minutes **noting down how it may or may not apply to digital minds, in the context of risks of over- and under-attribution of moral status. We will discuss your responses during the discussion session.
